开源离线二维码文件发送端，在浏览器本地将文件编码为连续二维码，无需上传服务器。: Open-source offline QR file sender. Encodes files in your browser without uploading them to a server.
在浏览器本地把文件编码成连续二维码，通过屏幕传输到手机。: Encode files in your browser and transfer them via animated QR codes to your phone.
是开源的离线二维码文件传输工具，通过电脑屏幕和手机摄像头传输文件，无需上传服务器: Offline file transfer from a computer display to a phone camera. No file uploads required.
通过电脑屏幕和手机摄像头离线传输文件。无需服务器，支持网页与 Android 接: Transfer files offline through a screen and camera, without a file server.
电脑屏幕接收端，通过捕获屏幕、窗口或浏览器标签页接收离线二维码文件流，不使用摄像: Receive offline QR transfers through screen, window, or tab capture without using a camera.
捕获屏幕、窗口或浏览器标签页，接收 BeamFerry 离线二维码文件流。: Receive QR transfers by capturing a screen, window, or browser tab.
仅使用屏幕捕获，不访问摄像头。建议优先选择二维码所在的窗口或标签页，并确保完整画: Uses screen capture only, never your camera. Choose the tab or window with the full QR display. HTTPS or localhost is required.
推荐发送端：四码 · 2068 B · 30 FPS。四个码完整入镜后保持手机稳: Recommended: four codes, 2068 bytes, 30 FPS. Keep all four codes in view and hold your phone steady.
点击“选择屏幕源”，然后选择正在播放 BeamFerry 二维码的屏幕、窗口或浏: Click Select screen, then share the tab or window playing the animated QR codes.
四码需全部进入取景框，边缘留少量空白: Keep all four QR codes inside the frame with a little space at the edges.
生成超时。请用 Chrome 打开 sender/dist/beamferry-: QR generation timed out. Try an up-to-date version of Chrome.
网页接收端仅支持单码和四码，请切换发送布局: Web receivers support single and four-code layouts only. Change the sender layout.
长时间未收到二维码，请重新对准屏幕: No QR codes detected for a while. Point the camera at the screen again.
请选择正在播放 BeamFerry 二维码的屏幕、窗口或浏览器标签页: Select the screen, window, or tab showing the animated QR codes.
未识别到二维码，请停止后改选发送端窗口或整个屏幕: No QR codes detected. Stop and share the sender window or full screen.
未识别到二维码，请确认捕获画面中二维码完整且正在播放: No QR codes detected. Make sure playback is running and all codes are visible.
此相机无法热切换帧率，请停止后重新开始扫描: This camera cannot switch frame rates while running. Stop and scan again.
当前屏幕源无法热切换帧率，请停止后重新捕获: This screen source cannot switch FPS while active. Stop and capture again.
请刷新页面；本接收端的解码资源均从本地加载: Refresh the page. All decoder resources are loaded locally.
请在 HTTPS 页面中允许摄像头权限: Allow camera access on an HTTPS page.
请检查网络后刷新页面: Check your network connection and refresh the page.
文件描述无效或超出网页接收上限: Invalid file metadata or file exceeds the browser receiver limit.
校验失败，请清空后重新扫描: Verification failed. Reset and scan again.
解压失败，请清空后重新扫描: Decompression failed. Reset and scan again.
原文件校验失败，请清空后重新扫描: Original file verification failed. Reset and scan again.
复制失败，请手动记录缺失编号: Copy failed. Write down the missing block numbers.
复制失败，请长按诊断信息复制: Copy failed. Long press to copy the diagnostic information.
高速解码器不可用，已切换兼容扫描: Fast decoder unavailable; switched to compatibility mode.
喷泉码接收中，无需等待指定片段: Fountain decoding is running. Missing frames can be recovered.
当前浏览器不支持屏幕捕获: Screen capture is not supported in this browser
离线二维码文件传输与手机接收端: Offline QR transfer and camera receiver
对准电脑上的二维码: Point at the computer QR codes
选择或拖入一个或多个文件: Choose files or drop them here
扫码后直接打开接收页面: Scan this QR code to open the receiver
选择文件并生成二维码流后，此入口会自动隐藏: This link disappears when you prepare a transfer
二维码过密，请降低每帧数据: QR code too dense. Reduce the data per code.
模块偏小，请全屏后再播: Modules look too small. Use fullscreen for playback.
单码超过 30 FPS 时相机会拍到换码拖影，通常更慢: Single-code playback above 30 FPS can create motion artifacts and reduce speed.
分析流约 60 FPS，更高发送帧率不会增加唯一码: Camera analysis is about 60 FPS; higher sender FPS may not increase unique frames.
可停止后重开相机: stop and restart camera to apply
可停止后重新捕获: stop and restart capture to apply
下按 6 个 vsync 更新 5 次，quad full refresh: on a 60 Hz display, update five times per six vsyncs in quad mode
每个刷新周期四slot全部更新；30 FPS 原稳定路径保持不变: update all four slots every refresh; the stable 30 FPS mode remains unchanged
只占 2×2 上排。50 FPS 使用 60 Hz 的 5/6 vsync 节拍: uses the top two slots. The 50 FPS option uses a 5/6 vsync cadence on 60 Hz displays; defaults to 2068 B at 50 FPS
屏会尝试每次 vsync 全刷four codes；若unique符号率下降，请: display refresh attempts all four codes every vsync; switch back to 30 FPS if unique-code detection drops
50 FPS 实验档：60 Hz 下按 6 个 vsync 更新 5 次，四码整: 50 FPS experimental mode: updates the four-code display five times per six vsyncs at 60 Hz.
60 FPS 实验档：每个刷新周期四格全部更新；30 FPS 原稳定路径保持不变: 60 FPS experimental mode: updates all four codes each refresh. Stable 30 FPS mode is unchanged.
四码 30 FPS 保持原整屏同换路径；60 FPS 是每个刷新周期四格全部更新: Quad 30 FPS uses the stable full-frame update. Quad 60 FPS is experimental. Dual mode uses the upper two slots. Press Space to pause.
